full_judgment:
Gour Gopal Saha J: This Rule is directed against the order dated 4-11-80 passed by the 3rd Court of Subordinate Judge, Dhaka in Money Suit No. 186 of 1978. 

 2. Short facts relevant for the purpose of the case are that the opposite party as plaintiff instituted a suit in the 3rd Court of Subordinate Judge. Dhaka being Money Suit No. 186 of 1978, praying for realisation of the sale proceeds of sales and compensation amounting to Taka 35,31,922 against the petitioner and others. 

 11. In the result, the Rule is discharged without any order as to cost. The order of stay granted earlier by this Court is hereby vacated. In view of the fact that this is a very old suit, it is absolutely necessary in the interest of justice that it be disposed of with utmost expediency. The learned Subordinate Judge, 3rd Court, Dhaka is hereby directed to dispose of Money Suit No. 186 of 1978 within six weeks from the date of receipt of this order, with notice to the contending parties.
